name: fitted-loft-shifted-star
why: Two fitted stars paired seven points round, which do not cross. It was refused twice over: as a wall 'bulging 0.27 mm outside its sections' own extent', because that extent was the points' box plus the tolerance while the curve rightly peaks between points (the star's true y extent is 80.402 mm, its points' 79.889), and with a facet sag of 2.57 mm logged where two sections make the ruled loft the smooth one, because the sag search descended from a grid point on another sheet of the twisted wall. The size is the fitted curve's, which may stray from the true star by its tolerance between points; facet_sag_mm must be 0.
